strategies.name: Classic
strategies.goal: The original TEKKWORK brain: momentum and dip entries, locks gains when the trend fades.

strategies.name: Scalper
strategies.goal: Frequent short trades on tokens with active momentum.

strategies.name: Trend
strategies.goal: Catch stronger moves and hold them longer.

strategies.name: Dip Buyer
strategies.goal: Buy pullbacks instead of chasing green candles.

strategies.name: Sniper
strategies.goal: Trade less often and only enter the strongest setups.

strategies.name: Degen Gambler (New Pairs)
strategies.goal: Trades brand-new pump.fun coins in their first minutes, with tiny positions, quick profits and hard exits. Most new coins go to zero: this agent can lose all of its SOL.
